results.title: What Is Instagram’s Viral ChatGPT ’80s Photo Trend? Here’s How To Create Yours
results.description: A new Instagram trend involves users creating 1980s-style portraits of themselves using ChatGPT's AI image generation. Instead of simple filters, users upload a photo and provide a detailed prompt to reimagine it with retro aesthetics. This includes specifying hairstyles, clothing, and backgrounds to create authentic-looking vintage images.
